title: Midnight Feature Reel
description: A woman wearing a white theatrical comedy mask and 3D glasses sits in a vintage purple armchair, holding an open book of film strips. She is surrounded by scattered film reels, a lit candle, and walls covered in torn vintage movie posters, with a large arched window revealing a dark city skyline and mountains at night.
prompt: A mysterious woman wearing a white comedy theater mask and 3D glasses sits in an ornate purple velvet armchair, holding an open book filled with film strips. Scattered 35mm film reels and a lit candle rest on a nearby table. The walls are covered in torn, peeling vintage movie posters. Through a large arched window behind her, a dark city skyline with illuminated buildings and mountains is visible under a deep blue night sky. Cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, surreal narrative style.
